spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact exposed surfaces (UDPSocket, TCPSocket, MulticastController) and the exact context prerequisites the spec's [Exposed=(Window,DedicatedWorker), SecureContext, IsolatedContext] clause names, and prints the IDL including the sourceAddress member that is the v152 feature.

interactive.rationale: A run button re-executes all seven probes live into a three-column table (this page / inside an IWA), with a verdict that names the one failing prerequisite.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises a real capability read that explains WHY the interfaces are absent; the page's verdict does exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes secure-context-satisfied from isolation-missing (isSecureContext=true while crossOriginIsolated=false), notes COI-via-headers still isn't an isolated context, covers the no-introspection-API case, and the exposed-context branch tells you the SSM flag is still needed (status test — experimental flag insufficient).

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6208452397498368, the sourceAddress spec anchor, and the IWA explainer.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite mirrors these probes exactly, including the inverse assertion (udpsocket-requires-isolated-context) that PASSES on normal pages; verified executing on /conformance/ at 1 pass / 6 fail / 1 blocked on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright-driven headless Chromium 141 (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): run clicked — 7 rows render real values (UDPSocket undefined, isSecureContext true, crossOriginIsolated false, http: protocol, policies unregistered) and the verdict names the isolated context as the missing prerequisite; zero console errors; both viewport classes screenshotted and read, overflow 0.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts iwa-probe-ran on every run plus the explicit not-an-iwa fallback branch (or the exposed branch inside an IWA), with the real probe values attached.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; table headers stone-on-charcoal; the shared .support.yes/.no states style the banner; the note uses the amber-bordered stone pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Captioned table with scoped row/column headers, per-row explanation text, aria-live verdict output, one clearly-labelled 44px action button, focusable IDL code block.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Table in an overflow-x wrapper with word-broken values; measured overflow 0 at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Record the probe table from inside a real Isolated Web App
openQuestions.detail: The IWA column is currently stated from the spec and flag research. Build/install a minimal signed IWA with direct-sockets granted, launch with --enable-blink-features=SourceSpecificMulticastInDirectSockets, open this page's probe logic there, and paste the observed values (including isolated-app: protocol and MulticastController 'function') into the IWA column as recorded evidence.

guidanceConsulted.query: data table readable on small screens with assistive technology
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep real table semantics with scoped headers and give the table its own horizontal scroll container on narrow screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The probe table uses caption + th scope=row/col inside a .table-scroll wrapper; per-row 'why' text wraps under the value so mobile needs no sideways reading for the explanation.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce live status updates to screen readers after a button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Deliver post-action verdicts through a live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict is an <output aria-live="polite"> updated on every run.

summary: Capability-probe concept: every prerequisite of the Direct Sockets multicast surface read live, with absence attributed precisely to the IsolatedContext gate (secure context already satisfied) — the documented honest pattern for policy-gated features.
